g.text: Original staged grid: architecture, input limits and batch size
Within-stage validation marginal means; each split receives equal weight. Optimizer/architecture settings frozen by earlier stages can differ across splits.
Original requested GAT heads apply before the final layer; the final layer always has one head. A one-layer GAT therefore has one actual head.
Panels come from different stages and must not be combined as evidence of one globally optimal configuration. No statistical significance is claimed.
